_readme: Hand-maintained curation, applied on top of the automatic arXiv search. Edit via pull request. addPapers: arXiv IDs (or full {id,title,authors,published,url} for non-arXiv papers) to include. excludePapers: papers matched by the search that are not really Jev papers. banAuthors: always ban. allowAuthors: never ban. scholarProfiles: author name -> Google Scholar user ID(s); on Scholar only these profiles get tagged for that author, and same-name researchers are left alone.

excludePapers.reason: Submitted before Jev existed; matched the search by coincidence
